from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Real-World Application: The Sonic Bat", 
                          ["Bats use sonar to map their environment.", 
                           "The brain acts as a Fourier Analyzer.", 
                           "Echoes unzip into frequency peaks identifying shapes."])
        
        bat_asset = "/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bat.svg"
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Show a bat emitting a sound pulse
        bat_icon1 = SVGMobject(bat_asset, color="#FFFFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(bat_icon1, 'B2', scale_factor=0.5)
        pulse = Circle(radius=0.5, color="#FF4500").move_to(bat_icon1.get_right())
        self.play(FadeIn(bat_icon1), Create(pulse))
        self.play(pulse.animate.scale(3).set_opacity(0), run_time=1.5)
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF4500")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Visualize the echo returning with a phase shift
        bat_icon2 = SVGMobject(bat_asset, color="#FFFFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(bat_icon2, 'C5', scale_factor=0.5)
        echo = FunctionGraph(lambda x: 0.5 * np.sin(x * 5), x_range=[-2, 2], color="#00CED1")
        echo.move_to(bat_icon2.get_left())
        self.play(FadeIn(bat_icon2), Create(echo))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00CED1")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Display the frequency spectrum of the processed echo
        bat_icon3 = SVGMobject(bat_asset, color="#FFFFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(bat_icon3, 'E2', scale_factor=0.5)
        
        # Using simple Axes and BarChart, ensuring no "include_numbers"

        self.play(FadeIn(bat_icon3), FadeIn(spectrum_group))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FFD700")
        self.wait(2)
